title: Ricotta puff tart with lemony leaves

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Puff pastry, ricotta, egg, cheese and fresh vegetables are all things a home cook would have kept or bought plainly.

supermarket.reason: Ready-rolled puff pastry, ricotta, vegetarian hard cheese, bagged salad and radishes are everyday Tesco items.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a baking tray, bowl and grater are needed, and scoring a border is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: A 320g sheet with 250g ricotta filling, baked at 220°C for 20 to 25 minutes, gives a crisp tart that cuts into enough snack squares for four.

honest_times.reason: Mixing the filling, zesting, snipping chives and slicing radishes and spring onions fits easily in 15 minutes, and the 25-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including lemon zest and juice and chives, is used, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A full 100g pile of dressed leaves with radishes and spring onions makes the salad a real part of a light April afternoon snack, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Ricotta, egg and cheese give protein and the fresh salad topping balances the pastry, making a satisfying snack a family would make again.
